description: Split one PDF into several PDFs, either by explicit ranges (each comma group becomes one part: "1-2,3-5" gives two parts) or into fixed-size chunks (every=2 on 5 pages gives 1-2, 3-4, 5). Give exactly one of ranges or every. Returns each part inline as an application/pdf resource plus a structured parts list (pages, page_count, bytes, resource_uri). Limited to 100 parts and about 4 MB of total output; use pdf_extract_pages for a single range.

every.description: Chunk size in pages; the last part may be shorter

password.description: Password to open the input, only needed for a user-password PDF (owner-locked files with an empty user password open without it).

pdf_path.description: PDF source: an https:// URL or a data:application/pdf;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

ranges.description: 1-based page spec; each comma group becomes one part, e.g. "1-2,3-5"

name: pdf_split

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of this part's inline application/pdf resource

title: Split PDF into parts
